readerRules.missingRoute: show health unavailable without blocking the existing jobs response
readerRules.invalidPayload: show health unavailable without mutating jobs or starting the companion
readerRules.unknownStatus: treat the health payload as unavailable
readerRules.unknownIssue: preserve the needs-attention status and show a generic attention message
readerRules.missingWorkerPaused: keep health and jobs readable but disable pause and resume controls
readerRules.missingQueuedPhotorealPromptUpdate: keep health and jobs readable but hide the queued prompt-update action
readerRules.queuedKreaPhotorealSettingsUpdateV1: an additive boolean that means the writer accepts queuedPhotorealSettingsUpdateV1 bodies for both exact recognized Krea adapter ids under PV-ENHANCE-QUEUE-001; it does not imply backend readiness and does not change queue order
readerRules.missingQueuedKreaPhotorealSettingsUpdate: keep health, Jobs, and the compatible FLUX current-settings action readable, but block both Krea current-settings actions when the member is missing, false, null, malformed, or duplicate
readerRules.missingTerminalHistoryBatchDismissV1: keep health and jobs readable and fall back to protected per-job terminal history dismissal
readerRules.missingQueuedJobsBatchCancelV1: keep health and jobs readable and fall back to protected per-job queued cancellation
readerRules.missingQueuedJobsBatchReorderV1: keep health and jobs readable and fall back to protected per-job queued reordering without sending a final-order body to an older route
readerRules.missingTerminalHistoryTargetsV1: keep health and jobs readable and never redefine all as only the loaded history window
readerRules.missingTerminalHistoryBatchRetryV1: keep health and jobs readable but never retry only the loaded terminal history window as if it were all
readerRules.terminalHistoryTargetsV1Dependency: use authoritative targets only with the matching compact mutation capability: dismiss requires terminalHistoryBatchDismissV1 and retry requires terminalHistoryBatchRetryV1, so a plan never degrades into thousands of per-job requests
readerRules.missingPhotorealPromptControlsV2: keep health and jobs readable but block new photoreal submissions so an older companion cannot silently ignore Negative, LoRA OFF, or the removal of legacy hidden prompt text
readerRules.kreaAnimeToRealV1: a boolean that means the health writer and reader recognize the exact comfyui-krea2-anime-to-real-edit-v1-photoreal adapter row; it does not assert that its assets, backend, workflow, or runtime are installed, verified, ready, or enabled
readerRules.missingKreaAnimeToRealV1: keep health and jobs readable but block publication and retry for the exact comfyui-krea2-anime-to-real-edit-v1-photoreal adapter; missing, false, malformed, or legacy capability spellings fail closed
readerRules.duplicateKreaAnimeToRealV1: treat duplicate capabilities objects or duplicate kreaAnimeToRealV1 members as malformed even when one occurrence is boolean true; disable the selector and block publication and retry
readerRules.kreaAnythingToReal1536V1: a boolean that means the health writer and reader recognize maxDimension 1536 as the bounded author workflow only for the exact comfyui-krea2-anything2real-v3-photoreal adapter; it does not assert that its assets, backend, workflow, or runtime are installed, verified, ready, or enabled
readerRules.missingKreaAnythingToReal1536V1: keep health and jobs readable but disable the 1536 selector and block 1536 publication and retry for the exact comfyui-krea2-anything2real-v3-photoreal adapter; missing, false, malformed, or legacy capability spellings fail closed
readerRules.duplicateKreaAnythingToReal1536V1: treat duplicate capabilities objects or duplicate kreaAnythingToReal1536V1 members as malformed even when one occurrence is boolean true; disable the 1536 selector and block 1536 publication and retry
readerRules.deferredBackendSkipV1: an exactly true boolean that permits execution selection to skip only an exact member of the recognized optional non-Krea list at PV-ENHANCE-QUEUE-001 deferredBackendSkipV1.recognizedOptionalAdapterIds while leaving that durable row and its presentation order unchanged; schema version 1 has no members, and it never permits either recognized Krea adapter or an unknown, future, duplicate, or malformed row to be skipped
readerRules.backendAvailabilityKreaPhotorealV1: an optional bounded passive projection at backendAvailability.kreaPhotorealV1; when present and well formed, queueHeadBlocked is one boolean, and any additive details may report only exact recognized adapter ids, booleans, fixed reason text, and bounded queued or waiting counts, never paths, secrets, active probing, process starts, or queue mutations
readerRules.kreaPhotorealQueueHeadBlockedV1: backendAvailability.kreaPhotorealV1.queueHeadBlocked is true only when the first queued row in PV-ENHANCE-QUEUE-001 reader ordering has an exact recognized Krea photoreal adapter id and that adapter backend is unavailable in this bounded snapshot; it is false for an empty queue, a ready Krea head, every non-Krea head, and every unknown, future, duplicate, or malformed row
readerRules.kreaPhotorealQueueHeadBlockedPumpV1: queueHeadBlocked true is an intentional strict-FIFO wait: worker.pumpRunning may be false, but the writer does not add queued-without-pump or request recovery solely for this state; a reader suppresses a conflicting queued-without-pump recovery action only when its cached visible queue head is an exact recognized Krea photoreal row, and otherwise preserves the attention and recovery action
readerRules.invalidKreaPhotorealQueueHeadBlockedV1: missing, duplicate, null, string, numeric, object, array, or otherwise non-boolean backendAvailability.kreaPhotorealV1.queueHeadBlocked leaves this optional projection unavailable and fail-closed without making health, Jobs, or unrelated capabilities unavailable; the reader does not infer blocked true from engine counts or reason text
readerRules.kreaPhotorealQueueHeadBlockedDisplayV1: when queueHeadBlocked is true without another attention issue, WPF shows that the first photoreal job is waiting for engine readiness and later video will not start; any other needs-attention issue, including a loopback trust-boundary issue, takes display priority; reading or displaying either state never wakes, reorders, claims, retries, or mutates the queue
readerRules.missingDeferredBackendSkipV1: keep health and jobs readable and do not infer unavailable-backend skip behavior; readers never wake or reorder the queue from health
readerRules.missingAtomicImageEnqueueNext: keep health and jobs readable but hide or block enqueue-next actions so an older companion cannot silently append the job to the tail
readerRules.missingDisplayedManagedVideoSourceV1: keep health and jobs readable but block video enqueue from a displayed managed still so an older companion cannot reinterpret it as an Original source
readerRules.missingStoreBackendGeneration: treat the store as a compatible legacy backend and keep the existing jobs API behavior
readerRules.missingStoreRevisions: keep health and jobs readable; readers must not invent revision values
readerRules.inventoryRevision: an optional monotonic commit revision used for mutation-debt reconciliation; progress or heartbeat may advance it without a full Jobs reload, and only a catalogRevision-missing legacy reader may use an advance beyond its bound snapshot as a throttled passive fallback
readerRules.catalogRevision: an optional monotonic revision authoritative for WPF-visible terminal, new-row, and managed-media changes; an advance beyond the displayed snapshot invalidates that snapshot by the next poll, while heartbeat and progress-only writes keep it stable
readerRules.queueOrderRevision: an optional non-negative monotonic safe integer in store.queueOrderRevision; a change invalidates a cached queued ordering even when status counts are unchanged
readerRules.pausedDisplay: show Paused as an intentional state; if one job is running, explain that it may finish while no next job starts
readerRules.polling: request health only while the Jobs workspace performs its existing passive refresh
readerRules.timeoutPolicy: do not infer a stall from elapsed time alone
